d:
Ye log dekh nahin sakte lekin ab apni mehnat se dusron ki zindgi men roshni bharne ka kam kar rahe hain. dilli men lage is divali mele men manisha ne apne jaise aur drishtibadhit logon ke sath milkar apne lie diye, mombattiyan aur sajavat ki chizen banaeen.
Riport tapas malik
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
